name: Junaed Dar, Heathrow security manager (silhouette only)
depiction: Junaed Dar, a Heathrow security manager from Slough, convicted by a jury at Kingston Crown Court of attempting to import Class A drugs (the 22 kg of cocaine had been swapped for wood in Bogota) and jailed for 16 and a half years on 4 August 2025. Named because he was convicted and is widely named (NCA, Slough Observer, PA, HSToday). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette in a plain dark work jacket: no face, no features, no badge or lanyard text. NOT A LIKENESS.
